column1: Table 12.3.3 – Dowel Bearing Strengths, F_e, for Dowel-Type Fasteners in Wood Members

column2: Dowel bearing strength in pounds per square inch (psi) [2]
Specific gravity, G, shall be determined in accordance with Table 12.3.3A.
F_e|| = 11200*G; F_e_perp = (6100*G^1.45)/(D^0.5); F_e for D < 1/4" = 16600*G^1.84; Tabulated values are rounded to the nearest 50 psi.
